The subsequent timeout in Step 8 (which led to the eventual workaround in Step 10) suggests that relying on the direct URL provided by the Planner was error-prone. A correct planner would have instructed the WebSurfer to inspect the search results page from Step 6 or verify the exact URL before attempting a direct navigation, which likely would have prevented the timeout and the unnecessary Step 8 failure.
